items.title: EchoFG: display timing (the generated frame's present blocks 17-20 ms): vsync / VRR / frame latency
items.note: 2026-10-11 retest (x3 at about 30 fps, 4K 120 Hz, GPU scaling on): the FSR path's generated-frame Present takes 16.7-18.4 ms, EchoFG's 6.4-6.9 ms: the long wait was FSR's. With EchoFG the display shows two presents inside one refresh in about 19% of cases (refresh gaps 0:157 1:460 2:200; FSR path 0:~2) and the presenting thread comes back only 1.6 ms before the next real frame (FSR path 6-7 ms): 90 presents a second on a 120 Hz screen with little slack. Open: is VRR really on (Sync mode Default = interval 0, no tearing flag?), and the slack. Owner, 2026-10-11: Lossless Scaling's Sync mode changed to Off (allow tearing): nothing visible changes; Sync mode stays as it was. (The log had no new session after it yet, so the refresh-gap line for that setting is not measured.) BUILT 2026-10-11 (deployed to D: next): presents are put one to a refresh of the display (setting 'Put the presents one to a refresh of the display', on by default; from DXGI frame statistics; switches itself off on a variable refresh). The log says 'the presents are put one to a refresh ... (a steady N Hz refresh)' or why not. Offline it can only show 'not steady' (this machine's G-Sync window), so whether it is active at the owner's, and whether the 0-gaps (19%) go away, is for the live log: `dev.py logs` prints the per-engine gap shares. Audit of the presenter after that (2026-10-11): (1) the display statistics were never reset for a new swap chain, so a counter that restarted read as '4294967278 presents not seen' in the log (fixed: they start again with each swap chain, device or backwards count); (2) the refresh alignment's slot memory could drift into the future after a restart and pile all the presents at the end of the interval (fixed: forgotten after 100 ms, and it steps aside when the presents of one real frame cannot fit the refreshes, e.g. x7 at 30 fps on 120 Hz); (3) its 'steady' test took ~13 stretches to settle (fixed: 2).

items.title: EchoFG live: x3/x4 spacing, HDR10 (PQ), switching things while it runs
EchoFG is an addon of its own (ECHOFG), no longer inside the FSR Upscaler's panel
items.note: Owner's suggestion 2026-10-11 (the FSR panel was confusing: most of it does not apply to frame generation). ECHOFG: src/echofg/echofg_addon.cpp, built only with -DNR_FRAMEGEN=ON, deployed with deploy.ps1 -What echofg -BuildDir build_fg, its own log logs\ECHOFG.log, settings under addons.ECHOFG, recorder with Ctrl+Shift+F1. Needs NIS scaling only (no upscaler addon). Open: its frames bypass the other addons' Present callbacks (so Neural Rendering's compose is not applied to EchoFG's made frames).

items.title: EchoFG first-frame 50 ms hitch; further pass merging for cost (4K about 5 ms)
items.note: At 4K the first engine frame costs 0.3-0.4 s on the presenting thread once (1080p: ~90 ms): the first use of the shared frames by the second API (D3D11 Signal / D3D12 hand-over, whichever goes second); touching them on the start-up thread only moved the cost. The slow-frame log line now splits it.
